Re-audited 2026-11-02 (RELPREP) against the source diffs since b1c9a11af9: the layout_desc split (registration/diagnostics/store), the A1 header accessors and the keys_view/ObjectKeys changes add no descriptor writer. A test's static LAYOUT therefore carries only image facts plus an idempotent identity, and no test resets it. No new descriptor writer.
